Title: Ayaan's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Ayaan - 8 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Pallavi - 35 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez

Places

1. The park - green grass, swings, benches
2. The bathroom - a tap, a bucket, a mirror

Scene 1: The park - Day

[Ayaan stands in the park. Pallavi stands near him.]

Pallavi: "Today feels like a good day."

[Ayaan kicks the football hard.]

Pallavi: "That was fun!"

[Ayaan plays cricket in the park.]

Ayaan: "Really?"

[Ayaan goes down the slide.]

Ayaan: "This is amazing!"

[Ayaan plays on the see-saw with Mother.]

Pallavi: "Show me too!"

[Ayaan feeds the birds.]

Pallavi (gently): "Ayaan, look at this."

Scene 2: The bathroom - Day

[Ayaan stands in the bathroom. Pallavi stands near him.]

Ayaan: "What a nice place."

[Ayaan brushes his teeth at the sink.]

Pallavi: "Show me too!"

[Ayaan takes a quick bath.]

Pallavi: "That was such a fun day!"
